mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 68 degrees with overcast skies at Badger Ridge Middle School. Under a waxing crescent moon, look out for an ISS pass tomorrow at 5:35 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward Fitchburg and Madison, passing almost directly overhead. The overnight low is 63 degrees with no rain predicted.
The city announced the winners of the I Voted sticker contest and the council is finalizing updates to sewer and stormwater utility rates to keep our city systems running smoothly.
We have a busy schedule including the User Group Meeting today at Epic Systems, plus tomorrow features trivia at both Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On August 15, a 44-year-old woman was arrested for a first offence O W I after being found passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Since the store is currently closed, come by tomorrow when they open at 10 AM, and look forward to tomorrow's flavor, Caramel Chocolate Pecan.
